title: Design System: Yuenian Zhou Academic Homepage

display.purpose: The site name, hero thesis, and major editorial headings.

headline.purpose: Section and page headings below the hero.

body.purpose: Biography, research prose, CV entries, and reference text.

label.purpose: Folio indices, navigation, field labels, and plate captions.

motion.name: calm-reveal
motion.purpose: Page entrances and single-pass section reveals.

motion.name: plate-hover
motion.purpose: A quiet lift on archival plates for fine pointers and keyboard focus.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: A small-cap text link with a restrained cobalt current-page mark.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color:#6b655b; display:inline-block; font-family:'EB Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-variant-caps:small-caps; font-size:.78rem; letter-spacing:.045em; padding:4px 0 5px; text-decoration:none; border-bottom:2px solid transparent; transition:color 150ms ease,border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover,.ds-nav-link:focus-visible { color:#102b68; border-bottom-color:#173d99; outline:3px solid rgba(23,71,199,.24); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Research Index Line
components.description: One complete research topic on a ruled line with a cobalt registration diamond.
components.html: ℓ-adic and p-adic local systems
components.css: .ds-research-line { align-items:baseline; border-bottom:1px solid #b8afa0; color:#24211d; display:grid; font-family:'EB Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-size:1.02rem; gap:12px; grid-template-columns:8px minmax(0,1fr); line-height:1.45; padding:.48rem 0 .52rem; } .ds-research-line i { background:#173d99; display:block; height:4px; transform:rotate(45deg); width:4px; }

components.name: Plate Caption
components.description: A compact catalogue caption that pairs a cobalt plate number with muted metadata.
components.css: .ds-plate-caption { color:#6b655b; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; font-family:'IM Fell English SC',Georgia,serif; font-size:.61rem; gap:8px; letter-spacing:.025em; line-height:1.45; margin:0; } .ds-plate-caption strong { color:#173d99; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Contact Field
components.description: A readable personal fact beneath a small archival field label.
components.css: .ds-contact { border-top:1px solid #b8afa0; color:#24211d; display:grid; font-family:'EB Garamond',Georgia,serif; gap:4px; padding-top:9px; } .ds-contact strong { color:#173d99; font-family:'IM Fell English SC',Georgia,serif; font-size:.76rem; letter-spacing:.05em; } .ds-contact a { color:#24211d; font-size:1.08rem; overflow-wrap:anywhere; text-decoration-color:rgba(23,61,153,.38); text-underline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Keyboard Skip Link
components.description: An off-canvas ivory paper link that becomes visible on keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-skip-link { background:#f3ede1; border:1px solid #4b463d; color:#24211d; font-family:'EB Garamond',Georgia,serif; left:20px; padding:8px 12px; position:fixed; top:16px; transform:translateY(-180%); transition:transform 180ms ease; } .ds-skip-link:focus { transform:translateY(0); outline:3px solid rgba(23,71,199,.24); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview: The homepage should feel like a carefully handled page from an old mathematical field notebook: scholarly, quiet, tactile, and precise. Its visual authority comes from classical book typography, aged-paper surfaces, hairline rules, archival labels, and real image plates rather than modern interface decoration. The page combines old-book printing with a restrained Japanese/Korean zine sensibility. Large areas of calm paper allow the text and small cobalt annotations to carry weight. The result should feel designed and personal without becoming theatrical, nostalgic pastiche, or a generic portfolio template.
keyCharacteristics: Classical serif hierarchy with generous reading measure and deliberate line breaks.
Warm paper and warm-black ink; never clinical white or pure digital black.
Cobalt appears as a rare registration mark, active state, or image-plane accent.
Flat editorial composition using rules, columns, folios, and captions instead of cards.
Archival image plates remain fully visible and materially integrated with the paper.
Motion is quiet, brief, and subordinate to reading.

rules.name: The Cobalt Annotation Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is an annotation, not a fill color. Keep it rare enough that every occurrence reads as intentional.

rules.name: The Warm Ink Rule
rules.body: Use warm ink and paper neutrals; avoid pure black, pure white, gray SaaS surfaces, gradients, and multicolor decoration.

rules.name: The Printed Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Create emphasis with face, scale, italic, and placement. Do not use modern sans-serif display type, heavy geometric weights, or oversized headings above 6rem.

rules.name: The Flat Folio Rule
rules.body: A new block earns separation through spacing, a hairline rule, or a change in column structure—not a rounded container or shadow.

rules.name: The Complete Plate Rule
rules.body: Display archival images at their natural aspect ratio. Never crop mathematical diagrams, music, labels, or generated plate compositions merely to force equal heights.

dos: Do preserve the old-book, academic archive, and minimal-zine identity when refining the site.
Do let typography, whitespace, rules, and real plate imagery carry the composition.
Do keep research topics on separate readable lines, including ℓ-independence and p-adic Hodge theory.
Do use one authored entrance sequence, quiet scroll reveals, transform/opacity animation, and reduced-motion support.
Do check desktop and narrow mobile layouts with the real biography, email, mathematics, and images.
donts: Don't introduce SaaS cards, pills, glassmorphism, purple gradients, generic sans-serif type, or ornamental icon tiles.
Don't crop archival images to equal heights or hide their meaningful text and diagrams.
Don't turn cobalt into a broad background color or add competing accent hues.
Don't scatter bouncing, elastic, looping, or attention-seeking motion across the page.
Don't rewrite factual biography, research, teaching, or event information merely for visual balance.
